## ✅ What actually matters today

### 1. India and US finalise first tranche of trade agreement
- *What happened:* Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and US officials confirmed the first phase of the **India–US trade deal** is finalized and in **legal drafting** [[ETV Bharat]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Open Magazine]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQeHktdDN5a01TVDUtbVNDNV9GalRKcDZfMk15RnJiZG96OHg5QmdPWFN3WWVxMTVIRC03SzVMemIycm1KVGVOWWJQNWlwUDh4c09mbVZGVHBPMnpuazFKd2xKaHVNWEtWaWVEZHFCUG10UW9nTmNkeFFjRGtDWTBjclRYeExRY19hWTJGUDJRaTVCcVJPLThjSlh3X2FzejVoci1vMEFtc3M0VGlOWHpQeEln?oc=5).
- *Why it happened:* Months of bilateral negotiations sought to defuse mutual tariff threats and secure stable supply chains [[Open Magazine]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQeHktdDN5a01TVDUtbVNDNV9GalRKcDZfMk15RnJiZG96OHg5QmdPWFN3WWVxMTVIRC03SzVMemIycm1KVGVOWWJQNWlwUDh4c09mbVZGVHBPMnpuazFKd2xKaHVNWEtWaWVEZHFCUG10UW9nTmNkeFFjRGtDWTBjclRYeExRY19hWTJGUDJRaTVCcVJPLThjSlh3X2FzejVoci1vMEFtc3M0VGlOWHpQeEln?oc=5) [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- *Why it matters:* It provides tariff predictability and export relief for Indian goods into the US while opening targeted access for American firms [[ETV Bharat]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Deccan Chronicle]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- *Who is affected:* Exporters, cross-border technology firms, and bilateral industrial supply chains.
- *What happens next:* Legal teams will review the text before both governments formally sign and establish an operational date [[ETV Bharat]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Open Magazine]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQeHktdDN5a01TVDUtbVNDNV9GalRKcDZfMk15RnJiZG96OHg5QmdPWFN3WWVxMTVIRC03SzVMemIycm1KVGVOWWJQNWlwUDh4c09mbVZGVHBPMnpuazFKd2xKaHVNWEtWaWVEZHFCUG10UW9nTmNkeFFjRGtDWTBjclRYeExRY19hWTJGUDJRaTVCcVJPLThjSlh3X2FzejVoci1vMEFtc3M0VGlOWHpQeEln?oc=5).

### 2. US producer prices surge 6.3%, compounding inflation worries
- *What happened:* US wholesale inflation jumped **6.3% year-over-year** in September, exceeding the Dow Jones consensus estimate of 5.5% [[CNBC]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/september-producer-price-index-retail-sales-data.html).
- *Why it happened:* Rising energy, fuel distribution, and transport input costs fed directly into wholesale prices [[CNBC]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/september-producer-price-index-retail-sales-data.html) [[Reuters]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQbHR0bzBmX1E0Y3RlbjBYNTQwY2dUSENTVFJ5ajc5aXo1bjFqWGpyRmVROERicENVczd6RWJSMHRYR3dEVWJKNDdaS25NNXVEQ29xTThlMXVjQk1NRjdyZkkwR3NVaktQYXd0YzZFcEdYbHhDZE1kXzZnY3JQeGpnLWNXRzRxTnV1emlYdS1mOEdTd2JBVTJfSkpHWlZva3g0UUFMNm9ORQ?oc=5).
- *Why it matters:* Wholesale prices feed directly into consumer prices, dimming hopes for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts in the near term [[CNBC]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/september-producer-price-index-retail-sales-data.html) [[The Sunday Guardian]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- *Who is affected:* Borrowers, homeowners facing high mortgage rates, and tech companies sensitive to borrowing costs.
- *What happens next:* Markets will scrutinize incoming Fed commentary ahead of the next FOMC interest rate decision [[CNBC]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[The American Action Forum]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE85N0ZqTjFFcmh6X3hkbVpqX3lwTGhxRlZTNWpRVkFreXJIdzQteEVnaENaZHlZQ25MdU4wWGU1MmU0TVYwN2JLRXRWQmpsSnJ5WGduMFFmZzMteTZyOXE5WW1fWmNXREMwamdRVzVB?oc=5).

### 4. TSMC posts record profit and evaluates Texas manufacturing
- *What happened:* TSMC posted a sixth straight quarter of record profit and confirmed it is exploring expanding production into **Texas** [[CNBC]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/tsmc-third-quarter-profit-global-ai-.html) [[Bozeman Daily Chronicle]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

- *What happened:* Mukesh Ambani’s **Jio Platforms** filed updated papers to raise up to **$3.2 billion** on Indian exchanges [[Forbes]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[India Today]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 🇮🇳 India
- **Trade Balance:** India's merchandise exports climbed **23% year-over-year to $44.4 billion** in September, while imports reached **$74.61 billion**, widening the merchandise trade deficit to **$30.21 billion** [[Mint]](https://www.livemint.com/economy/merchandise-exports-september-trade-deficit-imports-tariffs-crude-oil-11792023752123.html) [[LinkedIn]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOYmJCVWM5NzlKTWYtSzN0VmRMcWRDRmRHYzMtS21jMWNiYlJOR0Y4YWRQM3pMcTNvZ1lwR0Vtck1FdUpVZkNfMEV2bFBLNEdIQy1vQWVYN1JQX2U2eDZWSkZsdExOWVdmSlZFQ2NTRUd1UjlCWlFOb3BiNGhyZjVFck9KRFJPa3hBcGtXYk5vQkh5OUM4aVVITURpc2EwaVZNOC1YbERub1QwWnVjT0lIMVdCV09kaGM?oc=5). Shipments to the US specifically expanded **11%** [[Deccan Chronicle]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- **Capital Markets:** Driven by the Jio IPO announcement and a rebounding rupee, the **Sensex soared 1,533 points (2.11%)** to close at 74,316, and the **Nifty 50 rose 1.66%** to 22,997 [[The Hindu]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[scanx.trade]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- **Banking & Markets Regulation:** The Supreme Court dismissed Yes Bank's appeal, ruling its **$884 million (₹8,400 crore) AT1 bond write-off illegal**, causing Yes Bank shares to tumble 20% [[Upstox]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5). - **Telangana & Hyderabad:** Telangana suspended the Chief Engineer of the **Yadadri Thermal Power Station (YTPS)** and deputed five IAS officers to oversee state power generation [[The New Indian Express]](https://news.google.?oc=5). ## 🎓 Today's lesson: Producer Price Index (PPI) vs. Consumer Price Index (CPI)
While **CPI** measures the price changes that everyday shoppers pay for groceries, rent, and fuel, the **Producer Price Index (PPI)** measures inflation from the perspective of the businesses making those goods. Think of PPI as inflation at the wholesale factory gate. When manufacturers pay more for raw steel, electricity, or shipping (as seen in today's 6.3% jump), they rarely absorb those costs entirely. Instead, they pass them down the supply chain to retailers, who eventually pass them on to you. Because wholesale price changes happen before items hit store shelves, economists treat a rising PPI as a leading indicator that consumer inflation may remain sticky in the months ahead.
